notes: This file is the ONLY source of model ids for the Foundry runtime. Any id not listed here is rejected (tests/model-policy.test.mjs).

Classes are capability/cost tiers. For open-weight models they follow ROADMAP §2.3 parameter bands; hosted Anthropic models have no public parameter count, so they are placed by price tier and must be justified by measurement (research/*/REPORT.md).
No silent fallback: the runtime never substitutes a model. Escalation moves up the class order only through logged events (rules E1-E7).

Costs: hosted calls record the provider-reported list-price USD (claude CLI total_cost_usd, costBasis=list). Local CPU calls record API cost 0 plus an imputed compute cost = wall seconds x imputedComputeUsdPerHour/3600.

2026-10-07: Claude Haiku 5.5 (claude-haiku-5-5) added as the first class-M model (owner notice: Anthropic replaced Haiku 4.5 with Haiku 5.5). Class M resolves to it; Haiku 4.5 stays listed by id for earlier pilots and tests only. Local S-class models are parked (owner decision 2026-10-07) but stay listed.
